The '''Eighty-ninth''' was a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Army|army]] unit comprised of five [[Company/Legends|companies]] of [[Pop-Dogs]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> the Eighty-ninth was stationed in [[Chakham Army Base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]].<ref name="MK" />
